name: coating-simulator-mobile
description: Android wrapper (Capacitor) for antifouling coating formulation simulator. Simulation ≠ measurement.

scripts.build: npm run sync-www && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run build && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && mkdir -p dist && cp -f android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk dist/coating-simulator-0.4.0.apk && cp -f android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk dist/防污涂料配方模拟器-0.4.0.apk && ls -la dist/
